name: DKSH Holdings (Malaysia) Berhad
summary: DKSH Holdings (Malaysia) Berhad, an investment holding company, provides market expansion services to consumer goods, performance materials, healthcare, and technology industries. It offers sourcing, market analysis and research, marketing and sales, distribution and logistics, and after-sales services; and invoicing and credit control, handling of inventory and returned goods and other value-added services.
